# Matchiq

> Matchiq by Skilleaze matches you to the right jobs with AI and auto-applies with ATS-ready, tailored CVs. Launching soon. Join the waitlist for early access.

Matchiq is an AI-powered job matching and auto-applying platform built by Skilleaze Global LLP (Puttur, Karnataka, India). Status: coming soon.
